patch.summary:
Choose Adobe Firefly only if your buying job matches “Adobe generative image/video — Free credits; Firefly Standard from ~$9.99/mo; Pro ~$19.99;” rather than Zapier's shape. Choose Zapier only if your buying job matches “Automation + AI — Free 100 tasks; Pro from $19.99/mo annual (750 tasks); Team from 2,000 t” rather than Adobe Firefly's shape. Workflow advantage: Adobe Firefly leans ai-image; Zapier leans ai-automation. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Positioning: Adobe Firefly is Adobe generative image/video — Free credits; Firefly Standard from ~$9.99/mo; Pro ~$19.99; also bundled in Creative Cloud.; Zapier is Automation + AI — Free 100 tasks; Pro from $19.99/mo annual (750 tasks); Team from 2,000 tasks; Agents add-on separate..
- Company-size focus: Adobe Firefly (solo, small-business, mid-market) vs Zapier (solo, micro, small-business).
- Workflow coverage skew: Adobe Firefly-leaning ai-image vs Zapier-leaning ai-automation.
- Researched limits: Adobe Firefly — Premium video/partner models consume credits even when standard images are unlimited on paid plans; Zapier — Task quotas (100 Free / 750 Pro) dominate TCO — multi-step Zaps burn tasks fast.

Limitations — Adobe Firefly: Premium video/partner models consume credits even when standard images are unlimited on paid plans; Standalone pricing is easy to confuse with Creative Cloud Pro bundles; Zapier: Task quotas (100 Free / 750 Pro) dominate TCO — multi-step Zaps burn tasks fast; Agents add-on is separate from the Pro $19.99 floor.
